limitations: Declared format, MIME, URL suffix and size are metadata, not verified remote content.
A zero size is not evidence of a genuinely empty file; missing sizes prevent a full capacity estimate.
Per-resource declared byte sums may count repeated URLs and are not storage provisioning estimates.
Bbox validity checks do not prove administrative containment or observation locations.
CSV probing will inspect bounded prefixes; it cannot establish full date/geographic coverage or row counts.
First urllib transport failed with RemoteDisconnected; curl diagnostic succeeded. Exact transport discrepancy is unconfirmed.
Fixed sample of direct HTTPS .csv resources, no redirects/retries/archive/PDF processing.
First record is only a candidate header until reviewed; all novelty checks are literal metadata comparisons.
Prefix bytes are not a whole-file backup and establish no full row counts/time/spatial coverage.
No live indexing, retrieval, embedding or reranking was performed.
